description: Counts the points VEDUTUM needs for a job: reading a floor plan (per storey), an optional check run, images and 8-second videos in three quality levels (hd ≈ 1,024 px, praesentation ≈ 2,048 px, druck ≈ 4,096 px). Use when someone asks what a set of renderings or videos takes. Returns points only, with a breakdown; the 3D model, share page and exports need none.

check_run.description: Also run the automatic check of each storey

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German) or "en" (English). Default "de".

storeys.description: Number of storeys to read from the floor plans, e.g. 2

name: vedutum_estimate_points
title: Estimate points for a visualisation job
